parent_objective: critical-window config implementation and sampling validation

public_gates: add critical-window late high-energy zero-relvel config
run reset/sampling stress before proof mining
run small M399 behavior smoke if sampling passes
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not run proof mining before sampling stress passes
do not count M482 single-source events as proof
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: Critical-window zero-relvel configs can be sampled robustly and create a harder but non-saturated diagnostic distribution before source-diverse tail-aligned proof mining.
success_criteria: both configs are added and parse successfully
sampling stress has zero sampling failures across pre-registered seed blocks
each config has at least two obstacle labels and single-label share <= 0.80
failure_criteria: either config fails to sample robustly
either config is single-label dominated beyond threshold
behavior smoke is trivially saturated or broken
training or checkpoint promotion is performed

commands.name: sampling_stress
commands.command: Run reset/sampling stress on seed blocks 11200 11300 11400, 128 resets per block.

commands.name: behavior_smoke
commands.command: Run small M399 behavior smoke on both configs only after sampling stress passes.

decision_rule: M484 should admit proof mining only if config sampling and behavior smokes are robust; otherwise repair config ranges first.
